name: SARUM
confidence: read from a printed public-domain hymnal, unchecked
reviewNotes: Read from The Hymnal of the Protestant Episcopal Church (1916), hymn 295 (Internet Archive authoriz00epis, leaf 452), which prints it in 4/2 in minims; every note value is halved here (4/4 in crotchets), as the CCEH copy of the tune does (content/hymns/tunes/sarum.json, a draft held back for its bar 13). The two agree note for note except one length: the 1916 book has 'blessed' as a semibreve (2 beats here) with the first Alleluia starting in the same bar, CCEH holds it for 4 beats; with the 1916 lengths every bar is a full 4/4 bar. The Amen is left out. Barnby's date: the 1916 book says 1868; musicPublished 1869 is the year the tune is usually said to have been first printed — check.
